title: Banked Curve Speed Analysis
description: Interactive exploration of how vehicle speed relative to ideal speed determines friction requirements on banked curves. Features a friction vs speed graph, side view with friction direction indicators, and real-time status showing safe speed ranges.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: physics
circular motion
centripetal force
banked curves
friction
dynamics
safe driving
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of banked curve speed analysis
Explore banked curve speed analysis through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of banked curve speed analysis to solve problems
Experiment with parameters to observe their effects on banked curve speed analysis
